description.en: RoboProcessBench evaluates vision-language models on process-aware understanding in robotic manipulation, with 12 diagnostic question families covering static monitoring and dynamic reasoning over execution traces. The benchmark includes 58k QA pairs across 260 tasks.

evidence.snippet: To address this gap, we present RoboProcessBench, a benchmark for process-aware understanding in vision-language robotic manipulation.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing evaluations largely ignore fine-grained process understanding, which is crucial for VLMs used as critics or failure detectors. This benchmark provides a structured way to measure progress in this capability and supports post-training via a dedicated SFT split.
